title: Asian Crack Sauce - Vicky Pham

ldIngredientsRaw: 1 tablespoon lime juice (about half a large lime)
1 large garlic clove (about 1 teaspoon finely minced)
ldInstructionsRaw: In a small bowl, combine fish sauce (1-1/2 tablespoons), brown sugar (2 tablespoons, loosely packed), and lime juice (1 tablespoon, half large lime).
Finely mince shallot (1 tablespoon), garlic (1 teaspoon), cilantro (4 sprigs), and Thai chili peppers (optional). Add them to the fish sauce mixture.
Stir to combine and you are ready to serve.
